details.description: Desi Kulfi Frozen Dessert cup offers a taste of traditional South Asian kulfi in a convenient serving. It combines rich dairy, aromatic spices, and sometimes nuts, crafted into a creamy, frozen treat. This dessert is known for its dense texture and indulgent flavour profile, making it a favourite in Indian and Pakistani cuisine. Its rich, creamy taste will leave you craving for more with every bite.
details.usageInstructions: Break the tamper-proof seal and enjoy Kwality Walls Desi Kulfi with the spoon provided.

details.description: Indulge in the rich, creamy goodness of Kwality Wall's Kulfi, a beloved Indian ice cream that captures the essence of traditional recipes. Crafted with the finest ingredients, this frozen treat offers an authentic taste of India's cultural heritage. Enjoy the delightful journey through classic flavours in a modern, gratifying dessert experience. Kulfi's unique evaporation process results in a luxuriously thick and creamy texture, unlike regular dairy desserts. Whether shared with friends and family or savoured solo, this healthier alternative to ice cream is sure to delight all ages with its gratifying flavour and texture. Discover the perfect balance of tradition and innovation in every spoonful of Kwality Wall's Kulfi.
